description: This file defines an immutable implementation of the PolicyRevision interface, providing methods for comparison, increment, and conversion to long and string representations. It encapsulates a revision number and ensures immutability.

classes.name: ImmutablePolicyRevision
classes.description: An immutable class implementing PolicyRevision, representing a revision value with comparison and utility methods.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new ImmutablePolicyRevision instance with the given value.

methods.name: isGreaterThan
methods.description: Checks if this revision is greater than the specified PolicyRevision.

methods.name: isGreaterThanOrEqualTo
methods.description: Checks if this revision is greater than or equal to the specified PolicyRevision.

methods.name: isLowerThan
methods.description: Checks if this revision is lower than the specified PolicyRevision.

methods.name: isLowerThanOrEqualTo
methods.description: Checks if this revision is less than or equal to the specified PolicyRevision.

methods.name: increment
methods.description: Returns a new PolicyRevision instance with the value incremented by one.

methods.name: toLong
methods.description: Returns the revision value as a long primitive.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the revision value.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns a hash code based on the revision value.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this revision to another PolicyRevision.
